messages.text:
BL-1041 — Rescuing orphaned work made it LESS durable: a stash pop moved the only copy of a reviewed-sound fix into another role's uncommitted working tree, dropped the stash entry, and told nobody - the receiving role found work it could neither attribute nor sweep
What it solves: ## Related
Approval context: Found while settling a coder `note` that said some edits in its worktree were not its own. They were not a phantom writer - they were a deliberate, well-intentioned rescue by the coordinator. But establishing that turned up something worse than the attribution confusion.

THE NEAR MISS. The rescued…
